title: Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for p>2
summary: We resolve the three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem for every finite p > 2. Every $`W^{1,p}`$ homeomorphism between arbitrary bounded domains in ℝ 3 can be approximated strongly in $`W^{1,p}`$ by smooth diffeomorphisms onto the same target.

review.reason: Resolves strong W^{1,p} diffeomorphic approximation of homeomorphisms in three dimensions for p above 2.
